results.flow_security_relevance: Locks the immutable trust anchors for the entire factory deployment (quoteToken, vrfWrapper, protocolTreasury, and raffleImplementation), executes external calls to quoteToken_.decimals() and vrfWrapper_.link(), and initializes the master Raffle implementation with initialized = true and status = Status.Refunding so clones cannot be hijacked via the implementation.

results.flow_terminal_action: Writes immutable variables quoteToken, vrfWrapper, protocolTreasury, and raffleImplementation on RaffleFactory, and deploys the locked master Raffle implementation contract via CREATE.

results.flow_security_relevance: Enforces the 6-decimal precision assumption required by RaffleConstants.ENTRY_PRICE (1_000_000) across all raffle accounting, while relying on off-chain deployment verification for token authenticity since on-chain checks only inspect bytecode presence and decimals().
results.flow_summary: Queries IERC20Metadata(quoteToken_).decimals() and reverts with UnsupportedQuoteToken(quoteToken_) if the external call reverts or fails decoding, or reverts with InvalidQuoteTokenDecimals(quoteDecimals, 6) if the reported decimals do not equal RaffleConstants.QUOTE_TOKEN_DECIMALS (6).
